params.prompt:
Medium & Aesthetic: An authentic, unsettling 1990s found-footage photograph taken on a cheap Kodak disposable 35mm film camera, capturing a raw, eerie "cursed image" look.

Scene & Environment: A desolate, claustrophobic liminal space—an empty, dimly lit basement corridor with stained linoleum tiles, peeling yellowed wallpaper, and an unlit doorway receding into darkness in the background.

Subject: Standing awkwardly in the center of the hallway is a tall, uncanny creature with pallid, wrinkled, fleshy skin and unnaturally long, gangly limbs. It has a heavy, bloated, distended belly. Dozens of lifelike human hands and fingers protrude asymmetrically from its torso, ribs, and shoulders, splaying outward at unnatural angles. Atop its hunched neck sits a gaunt human head with deeply sunken, shadowed eyes and a massive, slack, drooping jaw frozen in a wide, dark, gaping mouth.

Composition & Camera: Shot from a low camera angle looking upward at the towering figure, slightly tilted and off-center as if snapped hastily from waist height by someone backing away.

Lighting & Film Artifacts: Harsh, flat, direct on-camera retro flash illuminates the creature in the foreground, washing out its fleshy texture and casting a stark, hard-edged shadow onto the wall behind it. Rapid light falloff plunges the far end of the corridor into eerie, murky darkness, mixed with a faint sickly greenish-yellow ambient glow. Imperfect 35mm film grain, slight lens softness, muted desaturated colors, subtle edge vignetting, and authentic analog flash glare.

Constraints: Unpolished candid snapshot realism, no cinematic polish, no smooth CGI sheen, no studio lighting, no text or watermarks.

Cinematic still, a medieval village baker standing off to the side of his own market stall, body turned slightly away, head turned back over his shoulder, staring at the exact spot where he is supposed to be standing. His mouth is completely closed, lips pressed together and slightly trembling, no speaking, no smile. His eyebrows are pulled together and raised at the center in deep anguish, eyes wide, glassy and wet with tears about to fall, pale and drained, the look of a man whose soul is breaking as he realizes he is not real and wonders what he is now. Stunned, motionless, devastated. His hands hang low and limp at his sides, fingers loose, one hand trembling slightly. In that spot behind the wooden stall stands a translucent ghost-like echo of the same baker, faded, desaturated, with a soft double-exposure memory haze and slight horizontal glitch tearing, smiling a blank perfect customer-service smile and holding out a single loaf of bread toward the camera, frozen mid-loop. Hundreds of perfectly identical loaves on the stall and shelves behind. The real baker is fully solid, warm natural color, realistic skin with visible pores, flour dust on his apron. The echo is cold, pale and grainy like a half-remembered dream. Behind the village the world fades into an empty grey wireframe grid void with a flickering half-rendered house. Warm golden hour light on the real baker, cool washed-out blue-grey light on the echo, strong contrast between the two. Wide medium shot, cinema camera, 35mm anamorphic, shallow depth of field, slight chromatic aberration and scanline glitch at the frame edges, eerie, melancholic and quietly funny. Leave clear empty space above the stall for an icon. No text, no logos, no real game IP, original character only.
Use image 1 as reference for location,pose, expression, mood. Use 2 as reference for clothes. 3 use image 3 as reference for the face. Smartphone photo quality.
